blocks.text: Kisi system ka heat content ya enthalpy H do hisson ko milata hai: woh jo doosri shaklon ki energy mein badalne ke liye azad hai, Gibbs free energy G, aur woh jo system ko muqarrar darja hararat par rakhne ke liye zaroori hai aur tabdeeli ke liye dastiyab nahi, T x S. To H = G + TS, aur system ki sari enthalpy sirf sifar kelvin par dastiyab hoti. Do halaton ke liye delta H = delta G + delta(TS); mustaqil darja hararat par delta H = delta G + T delta S, ya delta G = delta H - T delta S.
Delta G ke nishan se khud-ba-khudi

items: Delta G manfi (sifar se kam): amal khud-ba-khud ho sakta hai.
Delta G musbat (sifar se zyada): amal khud-ba-khud nahi ho sakta; is ke bajaye us ka ulat ho sakta hai.
Delta G sifar: na amal na us ka ulat khud-ba-khud hota hai; system tawazun (equilibrium) mein hai.

blocks.caption: Delta G = delta H - T delta S ka nishan

blocks.prompt: Ek reaction ka delta H sifar se zyada aur delta S sifar se kam hai. Kya yeh khud-ba-khud hogi, aur delta H aur delta S ki kin halaton mein reaction hamesha khud-ba-khud hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Kabhi nahi: dono terms delta G = delta H - T delta S ko har darja hararat par musbat banati hain. Reaction hamesha khud-ba-khud hai jab delta H manfi aur delta S musbat ho, kyunke tab delta G har darja hararat par manfi hai.

items: H = G + TS: G enthalpy ka azad hissa hai, TS darja hararat se bandha hissa; mustaqil T par delta G = delta H - T delta S.
Delta G manfi: khud-ba-khud; musbat: nahi (ulat ho sakta hai); sifar: tawazun. Barhti entropy ke saath exothermic hamesha khud-ba-khud; girti entropy ke saath endothermic kabhi nahi.
